Re-entry in this slice is a boolean flag rather than an information path.

Truthful provenance-bound outcome re-entry causally improves downstream adaptive behavior; the causal carrier is binding validity, not data volume — misattributed and hash-broken receipts are behaviorally worth exactly zero.

Misattributed outcome feedback is behaviorally worse than no feedback (-4.9pp, sign test p=0.016, 30/30 seeds), while provenance-hash-broken feedback is exactly equivalent to no feedback under any selection rule. Fail-closed provenance validation is therefore behaviorally load-bearing: it caps corrupted re-entry damage at zero information, never misinformation.
The live process's SQLite object is identified by its package version.
SQLITE_SOURCE_ID can map the running binary to an upstream source tree.
The selected SQLite runtime may lose acknowledged commits under concurrent writers and unclean process termination.
A SIGKILL crash oracle establishes power-loss durability.
HALT_CANDIDATE_CONVERGED must not be minted from low residual pressure alone; it requires low state change as well, and a short persistence streak is a useful anti-single-frame guard in H1.

Within the H1 ActiveAssembly boundary, a packet_id must be bound to one complete semantic/provenance payload: exact duplicate delivery is idempotent, while the same packet_id with non-identical payload must fail closed before ranking/selection.
First successful real Qwen3-4B Q8_0 execution on Hostinger Ubuntu

FRANK's loop-of-loops architecture does not currently require a new first-class ClayCode loop primitive; existing record/state semantics plus the already-needed generic function/recursion-control closure can represent loop families when schedule/update policy is explicit data in typed IR.
The next BASE implementation step should prioritize production control-flow/type-effect/evaluator closure over new loop syntax.
